prerequisites.title: Own Xero developer app
prerequisites.detail: Register an OAuth 2.0 app and get a client ID and secret for Composio.

prerequisites.title: Beta customers for certification
prerequisites.detail: New apps must onboard 10 beta customers before the certification form unlocks.

steps.title: Register Xero OAuth app
steps.detail: Create the app in the Xero developer portal and note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret, using the redirect URI copied from the Composio dashboard. Redirect URIs must be absolute with no wildcards.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test account connects.

steps.title: Onboard 10 beta customers
steps.detail: Get 10 real, API-active organisations connected; demo companies do not count.
steps.done_when: Certification form is no longer greyed out.

steps.title: Implement Sign Up with Xero
steps.detail: Prepare the implementation and listing text before submitting.

steps.title: Complete security self assessment
steps.detail: Answer the annual assessment honestly; an agent can draft answers on encryption, logging and authentication.

steps.title: Wait for Xero assessment review
steps.detail: Xero reviews the answers and may ask follow-up questions.
steps.done_when: Xero reports a pass or a remediation report.

traps.title: Reported 25-client cap
traps.detail: A developer forum report says unlisted apps are capped at 25 connected clients. Plan the move to partner status before launch.

traps.title: Beta customers needed before certification
traps.detail: The certification form stays greyed out until 10 active beta customers are onboarded, which can take longer than the review.

traps.title: Redirect URI rules
traps.detail: Wildcards are not supported; up to 50 absolute redirect URIs are allowed.

blockers.what_to_do: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement changes within 60 days.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan from the report.
